basic_details.job_title: HBCH&RC One Year Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 03.11.2026 for 01 post for the One Year Fellow (Hemato-Pathology) post on a contract basis at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre (HBCH&RC) in New Chandigarh. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/-, with salary determined based on relevant work experience acquired after completing the essential qualification of MD (Pathology) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by MCI/NMC. content_sections.heading: About HBCH&RC One Year Fellow (Hemato-Pathology)
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Punjab, operates as a unit of Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, which is a grant-in-aid institution under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The institution has invited applications from Indian Nationals through a walk-in interview for the post of One Year Fellow in the Hemato-Pathology department for the period of ONE YEAR from the date of joining.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Resume and 2 recent passport size photographs (mandatory). Date of Birth Proof: Birth Certificate/School leaving Certificate/SSC passing certificate. Educational Qualification: Mark Sheet & passing certificate for all examinations. Experience Certificate: Past Employment (Experience certificate indicating the date of joining and relieving) and Current Employment (Appointment letter and last pay slip). Copy of: PAN Card and Aadhaar Card. Valid Caste Certificate (in the format of Government of India), Caste Validity Certificate in case of ST, Non-Creamy Layer Certificate in case of OBC candidates is mandatory. Economically Weaker section (EWS): certificate in valid format. Persons with Disability: Physical Disability Certificate. PwD: Autism, Intellectual Disability, Specific Learning Disability & Mental illness with disability i.e. Specific Learning Disability(SLD). Original documents for verification purpose. Permission from their Head of the Organization for persons working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations and other Public Sector Undertakings.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may attend the interview at Academics department, 4th floor, Wing- C, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Center. New Chandigarh, Punjab- 140901 between 09.00 A.M. TO 11.00 A.M. Candidates are required to submit photocopies of mandatory documents and carry their original documents for verification purpose. Persons working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations and other Public Sector Undertakings must obtain the permission from their Head of the Organization to apply for the post & to produce the same at the time of Interview, failing which they shall not be allowed to appear for Interview.
